parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the metadata crawler. You can call ListCrawlers to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: StartTimeFrom
parameters.description: The lower bound of the run start time, in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp. The value must be within the last 30 days. If not specified, the default value is 30 days before the current time.

parameters.name: StartTimeTo
parameters.description: The upper bound of the run start time, in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp. The value must be within the last 30 days. If not specified, the default value is the current time.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The run status. Valid values: WAITING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, ERROR, SHUTDOWN.
